reasoning: The statement that humans only use 10% of their brain capacity is a well-documented scientific myth. Modern neuroimaging techniques such as fMRI and PET scans demonstrate that virtually all areas of the healthy human brain are active and serve dedicated functions throughout the day. Neuroscience research, supported by institutions including the MIT McGovern Institute and Scientific American, confirms that no vast region of the brain remains dormant or unused.
